import { request } from '@/utils/request'

export type MenuKind = 'directory' | 'page' | 'action'
export type MenuLauncherTone = 'primary' | 'warning' | 'success' | 'violet'

export interface MenuInput {
  parentId: string | null
  kind: MenuKind
  title: string
  titleEn: string
  icon: string
  path: string
  component: string
  permissionCode: string
  launcherTone: MenuLauncherTone
  launcherDescription: string
  launcherDescriptionEn: string
  sort: number
  keepAlive: boolean
  showInMenu: boolean
  showInTags: boolean
  affix: boolean
}

export interface IdentityMenu extends MenuInput {
  id: string
  code: string
  /** False when the menu still references a permission removed from backend code. */
  permissionActive?: boolean
  isEnabled: boolean
  isBuiltIn: boolean
  children: IdentityMenu[]
}

export interface MenuPermission {
  code: string
  name: string
}

const baseUrl = '/identity/api/Menus'

export const getMenuTree = () => request<IdentityMenu[]>({ url: `${baseUrl}/getMenuTree` })
export const getMenuPermissions = () => request<MenuPermission[]>({ url: `${baseUrl}/permissions` })
export const createMenu = (data: MenuInput) =>
  request<string>({ url: `${baseUrl}/add`, method: 'post', data })
export const updateMenu = (data: MenuInput & { id: string }) =>
  request<void>({ url: `${baseUrl}/update`, method: 'put', data })
export const setMenuEnabled = (id: string, enabled: boolean) =>
  request<void>({ url: `${baseUrl}/setEnabled`, method: 'put', params: { id, enabled } })
export const deleteMenu = (id: string) =>
  request<void>({ url: `${baseUrl}/logicDelete`, method: 'put', params: { id } })

import { request } from '@/utils/request'
import type { IdentityMenu } from './menus'

export interface RoleInput {
  code: string
  name: string
  description: string
}

export interface RoleOption {
  id: string
  code: string
  name: string
  isEnabled: boolean
  isBuiltIn: boolean
}

export interface IdentityRole extends RoleOption {
  description: string
  createdAtUtc: string
  permissionCodes: string[]
}

const baseUrl = '/identity/api/Roles'

export const getRoleList = () => request<IdentityRole[]>({ url: `${baseUrl}/getRoleList` })
export const getRoleOptions = () => request<RoleOption[]>({ url: `${baseUrl}/options` })
export const createRole = (data: RoleInput) =>
  request<string>({ url: `${baseUrl}/add`, method: 'post', data })
export const updateRole = (data: Omit<RoleInput, 'code'> & { id: string }) =>
  request<void>({ url: `${baseUrl}/update`, method: 'put', data })
export const setRoleEnabled = (id: string, enabled: boolean) =>
  request<void>({
    url: `${baseUrl}/${enabled ? 'setRoleEnable' : 'setRoleDisable'}`,
    method: 'put',
    params: { id },
  })
export const deleteRole = (id: string) =>
  request<void>({ url: `${baseUrl}/logicDelete`, method: 'put', params: { id } })
export const getPermissionTree = () => request<IdentityMenu[]>({ url: `${baseUrl}/permissionTree` })
export const updateRolePermissions = (roleId: string, permissionCodes: string[]) =>
  request<void>({
    url: `${baseUrl}/updatePermissions`,
    method: 'put',
    data: { roleId, permissionCodes },
  })
export const getUserRoles = (userId: string) =>
  request<string[]>({ url: `${baseUrl}/userRoles`, params: { userId } })
export const updateUserRoles = (userId: string, roleIds: string[]) =>
  request<void>({ url: `${baseUrl}/updateUserRoles`, method: 'put', data: { userId, roleIds } })

import type { TableColumnCtx, TableInstance, TableProps } from 'element-plus'
import type { VNodeChild } from 'vue'

export interface DataTableCellScope<T extends object> {
  row: T
  column: TableColumnCtx<T>
  $index: number
}

export interface DataTableHeaderScope<T extends object> {
  column: TableColumnCtx<T>
  $index: number
}

export type DataTableExportValue = string | number | boolean | Date | null | undefined
export type DataTableExportFormat = 'xlsx' | 'csv'

/** Native table configuration; data and row identity come from DataTable props. */
export type DataTableNativeProps<T extends object> = Partial<Omit<TableProps<T>, 'data' | 'rowKey'>>

export interface DataTableColumn<T extends object> {
  label?: string
  prop?: Extract<keyof T, string> | (string & {})
  type?: 'default' | 'selection' | 'index' | 'expand'
  width?: string | number
  minWidth?: string | number
  align?: 'left' | 'center' | 'right'
  headerAlign?: 'left' | 'center' | 'right'
  fixed?: boolean | 'left' | 'right'
  className?: string
  labelClassName?: string
  showOverflowTooltip?: TableColumnCtx<T>['showOverflowTooltip']
  tooltipFormatter?: TableColumnCtx<T>['tooltipFormatter']
  resizable?: boolean
  sortable?: boolean | 'custom'
  sortMethod?: TableColumnCtx<T>['sortMethod']
  sortBy?: TableColumnCtx<T>['sortBy']
  sortOrders?: TableColumnCtx<T>['sortOrders']
  formatter?: TableColumnCtx<T>['formatter']
  filters?: TableColumnCtx<T>['filters']
  filterMethod?: TableColumnCtx<T>['filterMethod']
  filterMultiple?: boolean
  filteredValue?: string[]
  selectable?: (row: T, index: number) => boolean
  reserveSelection?: boolean
  index?: number | ((index: number) => number)
  render?: (scope: DataTableCellScope<T>) => VNodeChild
  renderHeader?: (scope: DataTableHeaderScope<T>) => VNodeChild
  /** false keeps a column visible and excludes it from column settings. */
  configurable?: boolean
  defaultHidden?: boolean
  exportable?: boolean
  /** Excel and CSV use raw prop values unless this callback is supplied. */
  exportValue?: (row: T, index: number) => DataTableExportValue
}

export interface DataTablePagination {
  currentPage: number
  pageSize: number
}

export interface DataTableColumnSetting {
  id: string | number
  label: string
  visible: boolean
}

export interface DataTableSlots<T extends object> {
  toolbar?: (scope: { selection: T[] }) => VNodeChild
  actions?: (scope: { selection: T[] }) => VNodeChild
  empty?: () => VNodeChild
  append?: () => VNodeChild
}

export interface DataTableInstance<T extends object> {
  clearSelection: () => void
  getSelectionRows: () => T[]
  toggleRowSelection: (row: T, selected?: boolean, ignoreSelectable?: boolean) => void
  toggleAllSelection: () => void
  doLayout: () => void
  resetColumns: () => void
  getTable: () => TableInstance | undefined
}
